overall_reason: The article reads fully with scripts off and wraps at every width, but a broken script embed throws on load and the page fetches 13 font files and 3840px images for an 846px column.

score.reason: T-NO-SCRIPT and T-WIDTHS pass; T-WEIGHT-FOR-JOB fails on fonts and image sizes (ROB-018) and a script error on load fails ROB-015.

findings.title: Weight fits the page's job
findings.where: Fonts and article figures (figure.w-richtext-figure-type-image > img), all widths, tiles/1440-02.png
findings.evidence: performance: 13 font files (font_files fail; budget 4 to 6) while fonts.json drew one family, Suisse Int'l (12,531 glyphs); webfont.js also requests Droid Sans and Lato from Google. Four mood boards are 3840px wide and shown at 846px (4.5 times; the sweep's performance hits, WEB-001). Bytes are known for 8 of 74 requests, so the true weight is not verified.
findings.before: The page loads font families it never draws and serves 4K mood boards into an 846px column.
findings.after: Drop webfont.js and the unused Droid Sans and Lato requests; serve the mood boards with srcset at 846 and 1692px.
findings.why: A phone reader pays for 4K images and a dozen font files to read one article.

findings.title: Content and navigation do not depend on script
findings.where: Story page script embed, all widths
findings.evidence: resilience.console_errors: 5, including "Refused to execute script from 'https://www.nimblestudio.com/story/%E2%80%9Chttps://sdk.intent.upflowy.com/upflowy-inten…'". The %E2%80%9C is a curly opening quote inside the src attribute, so the browser resolves the URL as a relative path on the story page and the script never runs. A 404 and two connection resets follow.
findings.before: A third-party script tag pasted with typographic quotes fails on every story page.
findings.after: Fix the src attribute to straight quotes, or remove the embed.
findings.why: Each story page throws errors on load; whatever the embed was meant to do never happens.

findings.title: Room for other languages
findings.where: Header nav pill (Work, Industries, Technologies, Services, Insights, Careers), 1280 and 1440px, tiles/1280-00.png
findings.evidence: rows_without_room_for_35pct: six links in a 585px row, free_px -1 against needed_for_35pct_px 75, at both 1280 and 1440.
findings.before: The nav pill is exactly as wide as its six English labels.
findings.after: Let the pill collapse to the menu when it runs out of room, not at a fixed breakpoint.
findings.why: The site is English-only, so this is a readiness note: one more section or a longer label will not fit.

strengths: The article reads with scripts off: 10,477 visible characters, the same as the baseline.
The title and body wrap at 375 and the document matches every viewport width.
18 height rules use dvh or svh and 65 use aspect-ratio.
Phone and desktop show the same article text (the parity rows are a text-matching artifact and the QR prompt 'On your laptop?' is desktop-only by design).
not_investigated: T-STRESS: no hostile content was injected; long names, translations and missing images are reasoned from layout evidence, not observed
right-to-left render: not captured; readiness read from the stylesheet only
page load on a throttled line: only actions were held slow
layout shift as a number: this capture predates CLS recording
computed text-overflow per element: absent in this capture; ellipsis rows come from class rules and were checked on tiles
widths between the captures, 320px and landscape
regions behind menus, tabs, dialogs or a login that the capture did not open
true page weight: 66 of 74 requests are cross-origin without timing headers, and 68 requests were blocked by the capture (trackers)
T-FAILURE-PATH: async found no primary actions
T-LOCALE-FORMAT: 'Jun 2, 2026' and '20/30/50' were flagged as two date styles; '20/30/50' reads as a ratio, not a date, so it was not raised
contract: no 00-contract.md; inferred a Read article on an agency site, English only
